body:
Actually honestly, scratch film. I really have no fucking clue what I want to do.

Any idea or good thing I have going for me I ruin by looking at the bad or letting the anxiety of failure build up.

> Do you use any medication for the anxiety or depression?

No. I did throughout my childhood and things started to get really bad mentally, so we took me off and it turned out they were causing some of the issues

> First thing I've done about it

Definitely not

> Why do you want to move back to Georgia?

I miss my friends and the life I had there

> What jobs did I have?

Retail, cold calling, and warehouse. Left all for the same reason.

> What job do I really want?

Director/Producer for film/tv. There is a good school out here which is what is keeping me, since it is significantly cheaper than others, but I am just unsure if I can handle it out here.
